restlet.description: RapidBridge read API - the Middleware calls NetSuite on behalf of a scanning operator. Transaction list, transaction details, allowed bins for an item, fulfilment exception reasons, and the three bin/inventory levels. Read only: it creates nothing and opens no work item. Its own script so a scanning role can be given the reads without being given the ability to create an Item Receipt.
